messages:
deploybot: Canary deploy started for service/inference-runtime tag `v2.4.1-canary-202603` on prod-usw2 · sampling 5% traffic · commit `a1b2c3d4`
ci-bot: Artifacts built and pushed: `infra-image:20260314`, `model-q4_8b:sha256:9f7e`
obs-bot: Smoke checks queued: latency p50/p95, error-rate, kvcache-hit, mem-usage. Will post pass/fail in ~3m.
alice: Good — tagged release notes here: https://short.url/rwd-release-241 
bob_oncall: @alice noted. I'll watch the canary window. ping me if p95 > 220ms or error-rate > 0.5%
carla_sre: Can you confirm rollout policy? Is it manual promote after 10m handshake or auto?
dave_platform: Handshake is enabled for this pipeline: manual ack required by oncall after smoke gates. Automated 10% step only after ack.
erin_rel: FYI this build includes the small tokenization fix from #432, and a routing tweak for shard balancing.
deploybot: Health probe log snippet:
```
probe: route-check ok
kvcache: warm (83%)
auth-proxy: 200 OK
latency.p50: 87ms
latency.p95: 168ms
errors: 0.08%
```
obs-bot: Initial smoke gate: PASSED (all gates under thresholds) :white_check_mark:
alice: reading metrics — p95 stable, kvcache looks warm. Anyone seeing unusual GC or OOM logs?
carla_sre: no OOMs. A couple of transient 429s on one shard, likely backpressure during cache warm. It's 0.12% of requests. keeping an eye.
bob_oncall: I can ack if we keep under 0.5% errors and p95 < 250ms for 10m window. Starting my 10m watch now.
deploybot: Canary is routing to instances: 8 nodes (g5.x8), avg util 62%
erin_rel: tagging note: we should pin `v2.4.1` to `release-2026-03-14` once promoted to stable.
dave_platform: ops checklist: tag pin, update staging aliases, notify infra-sla channel, update traffic-split.
ci-bot: Integration tests that run against canary passed: rerank smoke, embedding sanity, safety-checks all green.
carla_sre: small alert: one node saw spike in cache-miss ratio around 00:04 UTC, normalized. recording in post-deploy notes.
alice: thanks. @bob_oncall, any objections to promote after your ack?
bob_oncall: no objections so far — acking handshake. :thumbsup:
deploybot: Manual ack received from `bob_oncall`. Initiating promote to 20% traffic.
obs-bot: 20% promoted — waiting for 15m observation window. Sending telemetry snapshots.
erin_rel: I've updated the release notes with the canary link and known caveats.
carla_sre: observing the 20% window — adding a short runbook note in case we need to step back: `deploybot promote --rollback-tag v2.4.0-stable`
dave_platform: ops note: if regression observed, we'll pin traffic to legacy pool and trigger emergency rollback plan.
deploybot: 20% observation window ended — metrics: p50 92ms, p95 178ms, errors 0.11% — all within alert thresholds.
bob_oncall: looks stable from my side. no spike. green to continue.
deploybot: Promoting to 60% traffic now.
obs-bot: Telemetry: no increase in error-rate beyond baseline. KV cache hit improved slightly.
alice: once 60% looks clean, prefer to do full 100% but hold a quick 5m watch after final promote.
erin_rel: tagging plan executed: creating `release/2.4.1` and adding changelog entries.
ci-bot: post-promote smoke tests running (sanity, perf smoke).
carla_sre: small note: increased tail latency on one replica during ramp, but it resolved within 2m. Not seeing user impact.
deploybot: 60% observation complete. Acceptable. Proceeding to 100% ramp.
obs-bot: 100% now routed to `v2.4.1-canary-202603` (promoted). Final check across regions: prod-usw2 ok, eu-west staging unchanged.
dave_platform: Pinning release in cluster state: `pinned_version: release/2.4.1`
alice: Excellent. Leaving post-deploy actions: update status page with release note link, send short email to partners.
bob_oncall: I'll keep an eye for 30m but call closed unless something pops.
erin_rel: Release note published: https://short.url/rwd-release-241 (includes rollbacks and rollback-command)
carla_sre: Added entry to incident-tracker for the small cache-miss spike for follow-up.
deploybot: Canary promote complete — release tagged `release/2.4.1` · deploy window closed. :tada:
alice: big thanks everyone. If any anomalies surface, let's use this thread as the source of truth.
ci-bot: archiving CI artifacts and test logs under `artifacts/2.4.1`
obs-bot: final telemetry summary attached to release notes.
bob_oncall: ack closing watch. :white_check_mark:
carla_sre: small retrospective note — consider staggering cache-warm shard restarts next time to avoid the transient 429s.
alice: recorded. We'll add to the rollout playbook.
deploybot: If rollback needed within 60m, use `deploybot rollback --tag release/2.4.0` — otherwise this is now the stable release.
